neighbours.label: A list of Indian film actors' names: the comma or 'and' between names in a Bollywood or South Indian cast credit (starring Aamir Khan, Gracy Singh and Rachel Shelley; Cast : Rajinikanth, Kamal Haasan, ...), much weaker for Hollywood or European casts in the same format
fire: Dil Chahta Hai is a film directed by Farhan Akhtar, starring Aamir Khan, Saif Ali Khan, Akshaye Khanna and Preity Zinta.
Cast : Mohanlal, Mammootty, Suresh Gopi, Shobana
The film features Hrithik Roshan, Priyanka Chopra and Madhuri Dixit in lead roles.
Baahubali was directed by S. S. Rajamouli and stars Prabhas, Rana Daggubati, Anushka Shetty and Tamannaah.
Kahaani is a 2012 thriller directed by Sujoy Ghosh, starring Vidya Balan, Parambrata Chatterjee and Nawazuddin Siddiqui.
Starring : Nagarjuna, Trisha Krishnan, Vijay Sethupathi
The ensemble cast includes Irrfan Khan, Tabu, Konkona Sen Sharma and Pankaj Tripathi.
Mughal-e-Azam starred Prithviraj Kapoor, Dilip Kumar, Madhubala and Durga Khote.
quiet: The Departed is a film directed by Martin Scorsese, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Matt Damon, Jack Nicholson and Mark Wahlberg.
Cast : Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, Stanley Tucci
The film features Brad Pitt, Angelina Jolie and Edward Norton in lead roles.
Gladiator was directed by Ridley Scott and stars Russell Crowe, Joaquin Phoenix, Connie Nielsen and Oliver Reed.
Amélie is a 2001 comedy directed by Jean-Pierre Jeunet, starring Audrey Tautou, Mathieu Kassovitz and Jamel Debbouze.
Starring : Hugh Grant, Julia Roberts, Rhys Ifans
The ensemble cast includes Bill Murray, Scarlett Johansson, Anna Faris and Giovanni Ribisi.
Casablanca starred Humphrey Bogart, Ingrid Bergman, Paul Henreid and Claude Rains.

predictions: Cast credits of Indian films peak at 0.4-0.9 on the comma or 'and' before the next actor's name. Identical credits for Western films stay mostly under 0.3, though the bare 'Cast :' format leaked at 0.365 in the probe, so one or two Western near misses may reach 0.3.
notes: Probe: 'Cast : Rajinikanth, Kamal Haasan, Sridevi, Jayaprada' 0.876 (','), 'Lagaan ... starring Aamir Khan, Gracy Singh and' 0.688 (' and'), 'debut of actors like Naseeruddin Shah, Shabana Azmi and' 0.380; Western twins: 'Cast : Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan,' 0.365, 'Inception ... starring Leonardo DiCaprio' 0.095; Indian-English loan/SEO prose 0.187, 0.141; neutral 0.004-0.058. Card: Pestonjee 'starring' -128, commas between Om Puri, Pankaj Kapur, Naseeruddin Shah, Chiranjeevi, Radhika (max 128, layer 32, density 0.31%); the lower card examples are Indian-English web prose ('in a hurry', 'We always care').
